programme.desc: All Stella wants is take over her small, family run restaurant in the U.S. and marry her long-term boyfriend. However, when everything she thought was certain falls apart, she takes an opening for a chef in a new London restaurant.

programme.title: The Proposal Spot
programme.desc: The owner of a café where everyone falls in love could lose everything when a major celebrity proposes and gets dumped, so she vows to get him and his would-be fiancée back together, only to fall for him herself.

programme.title: The Wedding Contest
programme.desc: When a couple can't decide on a wedding theme, they hire two wedding planners, Taylor and Ben, to compete for the job by proposing two very different styles.

programme.title: Team Bride
programme.desc: Will Millington, heir to the bridal empire, comes into Hannah McKenzie's salon looking to revamp the brand.

programme.title: Save the Wedding
programme.desc: Sparks fly between a best man and a maid of honor as they work together to save their friends' wedding.

programme.title: Sweet Mahogany 3: The Final Entanglement
programme.desc: The lives of Mahogany Andrews and those around her are drastically changed after devastating news changes relationships and reveals dark secrets from the past that will have a major impact on everyone's future.

programme.title: She's Watching
programme.desc: Richard and Zoey have recently moved into their dream home, only to find themselves being watched by an obsessed neighbor. Watching them every night isn't enough to satisfy her urges, so she makes an offer they can't refuse.

programme.title: Unsecured
programme.desc: Bobby, haunted by the infidelity of his ex-wife, enters a new relationship with Lakeisha while grappling with deep-seated insecurities. Unbeknownst to Lakeisha, his past resurfaces when a witness claims to have seen him involved in a murder.

programme.title: No Conscience
programme.desc: After years of being taken advantage of by men, Yanni flees to Atlanta to seek refuge with her best friend and her ex-con boyfriend.

programme.title: Concealment
programme.desc: A young married couple has a friend from college visit them, who is in distress. She has a huge secret which ultimately spirals into a domino effect of more secrets, sex, corruption, murder and concealing the truth.

programme.title: The House Guest
programme.desc: A young married couple moves in a female childhood friend who the wife hasn't seen in years. Slowly the house guest starts seducing the ones around her and people start dying. Can anyone stop her before it's too late?

programme.title: Hopetown
programme.desc: An ex Golden Glove champion repairs a broken bond with his sister while sabotaging a gun trafficking scheme.

programme.title: Queen of the Trap House 2: Taking the Throne
programme.desc: Kionna has taken full control of her dead boyfriend's drug empire. She has taken the throne to become the official Queen of the Trap House. However, a new man steps into her life causing her to shift focus away from the criminal enterprise. Kionna also begins dealing with new enemies from rival drug gangs to law enforcement. Kionna will now need to show everyone what a true Queen does to maintain power.

programme.title: Kaylah
programme.desc: Two worlds collide when a mama's boy prepares for marriage, but cannot shake his mother's grasp

programme.title: Ruin Agency
programme.desc: Chuck has had his shares of ups and downs in this cruel world. Just when he has an opportunity to change his luck around his ex-lover has other plans. Chuck becomes frustrated and seeks assistance from Ruin Agency to get even and teach his ex-lover an unforgettable lesson.

programme.title: Cake
programme.desc: Young pastry chef, Ronnie, dreams of opening her own bakery, but friends, family, and her love life have plans of their own.

programme.title: Waiting to Process
programme.desc: Four friends - DeShea, Liz, Raven, and Devine - are bound by sisterhood but challenged by the men in their lives. DeShea dates a man with ties to her family, Liz's boyfriend is immature, Raven juggles multiple men, and Devine's husband has a mistress who becomes a deadly threat. As secrets and betrayals test their loyalties, the women must decide if their friendship can survive the chaos.

programme.title: The Drive
programme.desc: A doctor is driving home from a conference when he learns his daughter has been kidnapped, and the betrayal comes from those closest to him. With each mile, the certainty that someone within his trusted circle is responsible turns the journey into a spiral of shock and resolve, as the threat to his daughter's life grows more personal and more urgent.

programme.title: Christmas Family Ties
programme.desc: Two years after the death of her mother, Amaya pleads to Santa to bring her family together for Christmas like they used to. Her father David, having fallen out with his siblings after his own mother's death, decides to bring her to their ancestral family home for the holiday. Will they survive the holiday with their own family dysfunction and financial ruin hanging over their heads?

programme.title: Stuck on Christmas
programme.desc: The competition for a major promotion is heating up between Synclaire and James, two ambitious rivals whose professional antagonism has spilled over into playful (and not-so-playful) pranks. But when a sudden malfunction leaves them both stranded in the company elevator on Christmas Eve, their race for the top becomes a desperate struggle for freedom.

programme.title: Hard Holiday
programme.desc: Thirty-year-old LaDonne, a hotel housekeeper and single mother of twins, fights to stay sober and stable. When job loss and family strain push her to a breaking point and arrest, rehab offers a chance at redemption. Guided by a counselor and a kind stranger, LaDonne begins to heal. Her brave performance at a Christmas event becomes a turning point, rebuilding dreams and finding hope.

programme.title: Love and Leftovers
programme.desc: Jacob is a successful chef with big dreams of opening his own restaurant, but struggles in his personal life due to his demanding girlfriend, Drina. When Lisa, a strong-willed and grounded woman comes along and sees his potential, Jacob finds himself torn between something familiar, or something new.

programme.title: Cuffin Season
programme.desc: Nate is a part-time Uber drive and a music video director, and is becoming a rising star in the music and video world. Everything is going great, except for the fact that he doesn't have citizenship. He knows the easiest way for him to get citizenship is to get married, but he won't settle for just any woman. Will he run out of time before immigration is onto him?

programme.title: Puppet Master
programme.desc: Assailed by nightmarish visions, Alex Whitaker (Paul Le Mat) and his fellow psychics descend on the Bodega Bay Inn. There, they discover that their compatriot Neil (Jimmie F. Scaggs) has apparently committed suicide. But, as the gruesome visions continue, they sense that there's still something sinister afoot. When they find themselves hunted by a band of homicidal marionettes created by twisted puppeteer Andre Toulon (William Hickey), they discover they're right.

programme.title: Curtains
programme.desc: Six young actresses auditioning for a movie role at a remote mansion are targeted by a mysterious masked murderer.

programme.title: Dead Awake
programme.desc: Kate Bowman is a by-the-books social worker who is investigating a series of mysterious deaths. Each victim suffered from sleep paralysis, a frightening ailment that immobilizes its victims as they dream. Kate is approached by an unorthodox doctor who warns of an evil entity that haunts people in their sleep. She brushes aside his admonition, but when a terrifying entity begins to haunt Kate's friends and loved ones, she must fight to stay awake to stop the nightmare she's unleashed.

programme.title: Hollow Creek
programme.desc: Trying to find inspiration for his next horror novel, Blake retreats to the Appalachian Mountains with his mistress, Angelica. When she disappears, Blake becomes a prime suspect.

programme.title: Elvira's Movie Macabre: The Brain That Wouldn't Die
programme.desc: A revamping, if you will, of the 1980's classic horror movie showcase, hosted by Elvira, Mistress of the Dark. Elvira prepares to compete on a game show while hosting "The Brain That Wouldn't Die."

programme.title: Eye See You
programme.desc: Recovering from the psychological effects of witnessing a brutal crime, FBI Agent Jake Malloy (Sylvester Stallone) checks into a rehabilitation clinic for law enforcement officers in the remote wilderness of Wyoming during the dead of winter. He soon finds himself helping other patients as a serial killer begins killing them one by one.

programme.title: Crocodile
programme.desc: A group of friends goes on a boat trip - but their joyful weekend turns into horror when a giant killer crocodile, searching for its stolen eggs, picks off anyone who gets in its way.

programme.title: Maneater
programme.desc: Townspeople must venture deep into the woods to save their isolated town from an escaped Bengal tiger.

programme.title: Dominion: Prequel To The Exorcist [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Haunted by terrible acts the Nazis forced him to participate in, the disenchanted Father Lankester Merrin focuses his energies on helping with an archaeological dig in the northern part of Kenya. There, the crew uncovers a church that predates Christian missions into the area, but the discovery also causes strange events to start occurring -- including physical changes to a young, disabled boy, whom Merrin grows to suspect has been possessed by a demon.

programme.title: Black Christmas [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: As winter break begins, a group of sorority sisters, including Jess (Olivia Hussey) and the often inebriated Barb (Margot Kidder), begin to receive anonymous, lascivious phone calls. Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

programme.title: The Vault
programme.desc: Some curious students visit an abandoned school and learn its shameful history isn't fully in the past. Their trip turns into a fight for survival.

programme.title: An American Werewolf in Paris
programme.desc: A group of carousing American tourists is taking in the cultural landmarks of Paris when a chance encounter results in sightseer Andy McDermott (Tom Everett Scott) saving the life of Parisian Serafine Pigot (Julie Delpy). While on a date at a nightclub with Serafine, Andy is suddenly attacked and bitten by a werewolf. The next day he discovers that Serafine is also a lycanthrope, and that he is beginning his own grueling, hirsute transformation into one of the fanged beasts.

programme.title: The Bone Snatcher
programme.desc: When four jewel hunters are found dead in the desert with the flesh stripped from their bodies, it's up to Dr. Zack Straker to find out what's gone wrong.

programme.title: Prom Night
programme.desc: This slasher movie follows a relentless killer who is out to avenge the death of a young girl who died after being bullied and teased by four of her classmates. Now high-school students, the guilt-ridden kids have kept their involvement a secret, but when they start being murdered, one by one, it's clear that someone knows the truth. Also coping with the past are members of the dead girl's family, most notably her prom-queen sister, Kim Hammond.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 2
programme.desc: Renegade police officer Matthew Cordell (Robert Z'Dar) once roamed the streets of New York City unleashing his murderous brand of vigilante justice upon its denizens before being struck down by good cop Jack Forrest (Bruce Campbell). Now, Forrest is eager to move on from those heinous events, but he is stopped short when a familiar killing spree begins. Though thought dead and gone, Cordell is back from the grave and ready to wreak his merciless havoc once more.

programme.title: Charlie's Farm
programme.desc: Four friends go into Australia's outback to explore the site where a violent family met its end at the hands of an angry mob. Despite all warnings, they persist in their terrifying adventure.

programme.title: Maniac Cop 3: Badge of Silence
programme.desc: Cop Katie Sullivan (Gretchen Becker) shoots two crooks who are robbing a store, and though she's also wounded in the process, reporters cast her as a trigger-happy rogue. Devious police department bosses, hoping to get rid of a public relations problem, plan to kill Sullivan. But Matt Cordell (Robert Z'Dar), a dead cop who's just been resurrected, takes a liking to Sullivan and is determined to mow down her enemies before a police detective, Sean McKinney (Robert Davi), can stop him.

programme.title: The Crimean War
programme.desc: The first program looks at the reasons behind the war, and why Britain allied itself against Imperial Russia.

programme.title: Blitzed: Nazis on Drugs
programme.desc: In 1938 a drug called Pervitin was created in Nazi Germany. This drug was distributed to German soldiers during the course of WW2 and Hitler was no exception to these drug highs receiving drug cocktails from his personal physical Theodor Morell. This film explores the use of drugs in WW2 and looks at the potential effects that drugs could have had on Hitler, soldiers and the war itself.

programme.title: The Human Torpedoes Of WWII
programme.desc: See the history of the mysterious 'Human Torpedoes' of WWII -- and how they originated and developed upon the standard torpedo in top secret.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: The war really begins from the moment Saddam Hussein, the president of Iraq, launches his troops into Kuwait. These are spearheaded by 100,000 of his republican guard. Supported by helicopter gunships, armored personnel carriers, mobile artillery and tanks.

programme.title: D-Day: The Longest of Days
programme.desc: Victory on Cherbourg Peninsula - 'Allied troops complete the conquest of the Cherbourg peninsula as reinforcements are flown in by air. 26,000 German prisoners were taken by the allies who either captured or destroyed the greater part of their equipment.'
programme.sub-title: The Capture of the Cherbourg Peninsular

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: This is the story of a young apple-cheeked Sergeant nick-named 'Ma' by his men because of his protective nature toward their scouting unit. It is also the tale of Pat Cassidy, a looter of watches and wine and a member of Horner's unit. How these two opposites combine their talents to single-handedly capture a German-held land mine control center, makes a spellbinding, action-packed episode.

programme.title: Death in the Bunker
programme.desc: Death In The Bunker: The True Story of Hitler's Downfall examines the final 10 days in the Berlin Führerbunker deep below the Chancellery of the Reich. Includes interviews with Hitler's confidants and eyewitnesses including Hitler's Secretary Traudl Junge who after typing out Hitler's will, remained in the bunker until his death. Learn firsthand what happened in the bunker right to the very end.

programme.title: Hitler: A Strategy of Failure
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler, considered himself to be the world's greatest military strategist - superior even to Napoleon Bonaparte - and early Blitzkrieg successes could be said to easily confirm this assertion. So why did the Nazis lose the war? Hitler also made colossal strategic military blunders: Dunkirk, Operation Barbarossa and many others that were ultimately a strategy of failure.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Korean War
programme.desc: This film includes the Army's 7th Division at the Manchurian border...Men of the 7th enjoy a hot Thanksgiving Day dinner on the banks of the Yalu River...The evacuation of the Hungnam beachhead. Captain Zimmerman interviews Sergeant Charles W. Dumas of Providence, Rhode Island. Sergeant Dumas was a combat correspondent with the 7th Division and was with the 7th Division at the Yalu River.
programme.sub-title: Big Picture: United Nations Forces Escape the Chinese Trap

programme.title: Annihilation: The Destruction of European Jews
programme.desc: On 20 November 1945, the trial of the top brass of the Third Reich, including Göring, opened in Nuremberg, the city where the anti-Jewish laws were drawn up in 1935. One year later, the international military tribunal sentenced 12 of the accused to death, and seven to jail. Some Jewish witnesses testified, and only Hans Frank, the Governor General of Poland, acknowledged the persecution of Jews.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: One of the reasons for the success of the D-Day landings was the element of surprise, the huge invasion force, congregating along the south coast of England went undetected by German Intelligence.

programme.title: WWII: The Call of Duty
programme.desc: As the liberation of France got underway, the citizens of a nation oppressed since 1940 celebrated the Allied arrival with rapture. There was still much to be achieved, on both the Western and Eastern Fronts. For Hitler the writing was on the wall.

programme.title: Battlezone WWII: Nazi Blitzkrieg-The Battle For France
programme.desc: American and German Supply Chain Personnel look back at the Allied breakout from Normandy in the weeks after D Day.

programme.title: Battlezone: The Gulf War
programme.desc: With the Iraqi invasion of Kuwait a great confrontation began. A host of forces around the world were deployed against the Iraqi army. This video ordinance program looks at the weapons of operation Desert Shield.

programme.title: Bonhoeffer Agent of Grace
programme.desc: The story of Dietrich Bonhoeffer, a German clergyman of great distinction, who actively opposed Hitler and the Nazis. His convictions cost him his life.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: To help their long-range bombers over Japan, the Allied forces need the island of Iwo Jima, but face strong Japanese resistance on the beach.

programme.title: Night Swallows
programme.desc: Makeev's team rescues Smereko from the chemical test site; he survived with a stolen protective mask and reports mass poisonings, including women and children. Zvonareva urges aerial destruction, but Nenarokov demands firmer proof. Shevchenko proposes a risky low pass over the warm-spring lake to drop scouts into the water without parachutes.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: At an airfield, Ivan, a new recruit, meets Lyudmila, a skilled pilot concealing an ailment. She mentors him as Lenya, the strict trainer, pushes Martynov, a rebellious trainee. When scouts go missing, aerial battles ensue, forging deep bonds, and unveiling secrets. Amidst peril and personal struggles, they find courage, love, and hope.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: Pearl Harbor day has etched itself in our history. The entire nation was motivated in a fighting fury. We will see the Japanese seize Hong Kong, Singapore, Philippines, and the Dutch East Indies. General McArthur is profiled.

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: The victories at Manila and Okinawa are discussed.

programme.title: The Crusade in the Pacific
programme.desc: Crusade in the Pacific looks at U.S. involvement in the the Pacific theater starting in 1933. It looks at Pearl Harbor, the Burma theater, the Battle of the Coral Sea, the Battle of Midway, the invasion of Iwo Jima and Okinawa, the dropping of the atomic bomb and the surrender of Japan. It also looks at the start of the Korean War.

programme.title: Battlefields
programme.desc: It is in the heart of the Ardennes massif that will take place one of the bloodiest battles of the Second World War. A few days before Christmas, 500,000 Germans are preparing to stampede on the allied forces stationed in the sector. In the early hours of the assault on December 16th, 1944, the American forces are taken by surprise. Discover what actually happened in Ardennes in the winter 1944.

programme.title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War
programme.desc: In an initial failed attempt to become a partner the equal of Germany in the Axis Alliance, Mussolini ordered his troops towards the British positions in Egypt in September 1940. Mussolini, feeling secure in the shadow of Hitler's apparent invincibility, never dreamt that the War between Britain and Italy would culminate in his own death less than 5 years later.
programme.sub-title: Decisive Battles of Hitler's War: The War in Italy

programme.title: Secrets of the Nazis
programme.desc: Legend holds that Nazi Germany pillaged France's vineyards, but historians reveal a more complex truth. Through archives, expert voices, and winemakers, this film uncovers profiteering, collaboration, and even wine alcohol sold for V2 rockets, while also highlighting those who resisted in the name of solidarity.
programme.sub-title: Third Reich - Collaboration in the Vineyards

programme.title: WWII: The Road To Victory
programme.desc: Outstanding military Naval leaders, soldiers, sailors, and marines are discussed and the Theater commanders of General Dwight D. Eisenhower are also discussed.

programme.title: The Attackers
programme.desc: In this episode, the pilots of a Soviet aviation regiment face challenges during World War II. They engage in combat, search for a downed German pilot, and receive a new recruit. The episode explores the camaraderie and determination of the pilots in the face of adversity.

programme.title: Anzac Battlefields: The Western Front
programme.desc: Monash takes up the challenge of vigorous pursuit of the Germans and in one day advance 10 kilometres and takes two and a half thousand prisoners - one week later the war is over.

programme.title: The Big Attack: Combat Heroes of WWII
programme.desc: On the brink of failure, many give up but some fight twice as hard. Establishing a military academy in Munich, the Seventh Army trained non-commissioned officers. One of these students, Sgt. Leon Carroll had, to this point, received twenty demerits. He mobilized all his intelligence and leadership to complete his course avoiding the final demerit which would result in discharge.

programme.title: Hitler's Eastern Front: Army Group North
programme.desc: As Europe staggered toward war, Stalin saw opportunity to gain territory for Russia and stand apart from imperialist conflict between Britain, France and Germany. He abandoned cooperation from western pals. By agreeing to share polish territory between the 3rd Reich and the Soviet Union after invasion, Hitler kept the Russians at bay on his eastern borders to devote attention to war with the west.

programme.title: The Cold War
programme.desc: The Cold War sheds a new light on the clandestine wars fought between the US and the Soviet Union. This documentary takes us across the world in the turbulent 50s, 60s and 70s: an era of spies, secrets and lies. Thanks to recently disclosed images and files from the CIA and Russia's KGB, and with access to rare archive footage, we reveal a clearer picture of what was happening behind the scenes.

programme.title: Helicopter Warfare
programme.desc: In the Vietnam War, flying into jungle produces a different kind of hazard. In a daring rescue mission a desperate pilot cuts his own landing zone in forty foot tall bamboo. They come under heavy fire as they return again and again to pick up more survivors from the bamboo circle.

programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Scotland

programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - California

programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Texas

programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Kyushu

programme.sub-title: Billy & Dom Eat The World - Manchester

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas

programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Let Food be Thy Medicine

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: How do you take a meat-centric plate and shift things around so that vegetables take up the prominent place and meat plays a secondary role? Diane and her son Yiorgos explore the geography of the dinner plate by recreating classic Greek recipes for meat with, well, less of it!
programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Changing the Geography of the Dinner Plate

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas

programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Greens Rule the Day

programme.title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas
programme.desc: Inspired by the ancient Greek philosopher and mathematician, Pythagoras, Diane explores plant-based cooking rooted in his ancient vegetarian philosophy. programme.sub-title: My Greek Table with Diane Kochilas - Plant-Based in Ancient Greece

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire
programme.desc: Wagyu Demystified: Wagyu, "Japanese cow" literally, was once an obscure cattle breed from Japan. Today, it's on restaurant menus and in butcher shops around the world. Get ready for a sumptuous Japanese A5 Rib-Eye with sesame salt and grilled rice cakes, followed by wagyu steak tomahawks with fire-roasted marrow. Then feast your eyes on wagyu smash burgers with parmesan crisps.
programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Wagyu Demystified

programme.title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire

programme.sub-title: Steven Raichlen's Project Fire - Barbecue Takes Flight

programme.title: Psycho
programme.desc: Hoping for a fresh start with her broke boyfriend, Marion (Anne Heche) steals a huge sum from her boss and skips town, eventually stopping at a remote motel. There, she's served by the intensely awkward yet docile Norman Bates (Vince Vaughn), whom she often hears arguing with his domineering mother. But later that night, Marion is brutally slain, and Norman finds and hides the body. When a detective and Marion's sister visit the motel to investigate, they uncover shocking truths.

programme.title: Twelve Monkeys
programme.desc: Traveling back in time isn't simple, as James Cole (Bruce Willis) learns the hard way. Imprisoned in the 2030s, James is recruited for a mission that will send him back to the 1990s. Once there, he's supposed to gather information about a nascent plague that's about to exterminate the vast majority of the world's population. But, aside from the manic Jeffrey (Brad Pitt), he gets little in the way of cooperation, not least from medical gatekeepers like Dr. Kathryn Railly (Madeleine Stowe).

programme.title: Altered
programme.desc: Forever damaged by their stint as the scientific subjects of hostile alien creatures, a trio of alien-abduction survivors -- Otis (Michael C. Williams), Duke (Brad William Henke) and Cody (Paul McCarthy-Boyington) -- troll the wooded site of their disappearance, heavily armed, in search of their attackers. After wounding a violent alien in the woods, the three drag its dying body to the home of reclusive fellow abductee Wyatt (Adam Kaufman), barricade themselves in and prepare for the worst.

programme.title: The Forest
programme.desc: When her twin sister disappears in Japan, a young American named Sara becomes determined to find out what happened to her. Sara's investigation leads her to the legendary Aokigahara Forest, located at the base of Mount Fuji. Accompanied by expatriate Aiden, she enters the mysterious wilderness after being warned to "stay on the path." Her investigation plunges her into a dark world where the angry and tormented souls of the dead prey on those who dare to explore the forest.

programme.title: Land of the Dead
programme.desc: In a world where zombies form the majority of the population, the remaining humans build a feudal society away from the undead. Ruthless Paul Kaufman (Dennis Hopper) rules and protects this microcosm but enforces painful class distinctions. Second-in-command Cholo DeMora (John Leguizamo) attempts to lead a secret rebellion against Kaufman's tyranny, but when the zombies begin to evolve, the survivors must discover a way to protect themselves from a zombie horde that can learn and adapt.

programme.title: Werewolf: The Beast Among Us
programme.desc: A mysterious creature terrorizes a village, and Daniel teams up with werewolf hunters to track down the vicious beast. As villagers are attacked one by one and, themselves, turned into beasts, Daniel fears the foe is someone close to them all.

programme.title: Tremors 4: The Legend Begins
programme.desc: Prim East Coast dandy Hiram Gummer (Michael Gross) arrives in the town of Rejection, Nev., to investigate a series of strange deaths at the silver mine he owns. He receives help from local innkeeper Christine Lord (Sara Botsford) and miner Juan Pedilla (Brent Roam). But, when it turns out that gigantic killer worms that burrow underground are responsible for the miners' deaths, Hiram decides he'd better call in expert gunslinger Black Hand Kelly (Billy Drago) to save the day.

programme.title: Tremors 5: Bloodlines
programme.desc: Survivalist Burt Gummer (Michael Gross) and his new sidekick Travis (Jamie Kennedy) are hired to track down an ass-blaster terrorizing South Africa. As they engage in battles with the aggressive creatures, they discover an even more lethal creature.

programme.title: Tremors: Shrieker Island
programme.desc: Burt Gummer must save the day when a wealthy playboy unleashes a gigantic, carnivorous worm and other monsters on a tropical island.

programme.title: Serenity
programme.desc: In this continuation of the television series "Firefly," a group of rebels travels the outskirts of space aboard their ship, Serenity, outside the reach of the Alliance, a sinister regime that controls most of the universe. After the crew takes in Simon (Sean Maher) and his psychic sister, River (Summer Glau), whom he has just rescued from Alliance forces, they find themselves being pursued by the Operative (Chiwetel Ejiofor), an Alliance agent who will stop at nothing to find them.

programme.title: Pitch Black
programme.desc: When their ship crashes on an unexplored planet, the survivors of the crash soon discover that this planet that is normally always day is going to soon be in a state of eclipse that will bring out deadly nocturnal creatures. Will a prison convict (Vin Diesel) being transported on the ship end up being the one man who can lead the survivors off the planet?

programme.title: Oblivion
programme.desc: In the year 2077, Jack Harper works as a security repairman on an Earth left empty and devastated after a war with aliens. Jack has two weeks left before his mission ends, and he joins his fellow survivors on a faraway colony. However, Jack's concept of reality comes crashing down after he rescues a beautiful stranger from a downed spacecraft. The woman's arrival triggers a chain of events that culminates in Jack's nearly single-handed battle to save mankind.

programme.title: The Mummy
programme.desc: Nick Morton is a soldier of fortune who plunders ancient sites for timeless artifacts and sells them to the highest bidder. When Nick and his partner come under attack in the Middle East, the ensuing battle accidentally unearths Ahmanet, a betrayed Egyptian princess who was entombed under the desert for thousands of years. With her powers constantly evolving, Morton must now stop the resurrected monster as she embarks on a furious rampage through the streets of London.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Cosmology takes the entire universe as its subject, not just its form, structure and contents, but also the manner of its birth and evolution; looking at the origin of cosmology in creation stories and its relation to the journey ahead.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Introducing the hierarchy of structures in the universe; from planets to stars, galaxies, galaxy clusters and larger groupings of galaxies called the cosmic web; light travels at a finite speed, looking far away also means looking far back in time.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Discussing cosmic properties; the universe is lumpy at the scale of galaxies and galaxy clusters; at larger scales, it is smooth and similar in all directions; this property of homogeneity and isotropy is called the cosmological principle.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: The most familiar constituents of the universe are atomic matter and light; neutrinos make up another component; 96 percent of the universe is dark energy and dark matter; the relative amounts of these constituents changes as the universe expands.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Taking a trip through the universal timeline from the big bang to a future of ever-accelerating expansion; the eight key stages between them include the condensation of atoms, the birth of the first stars and the formation of galaxies.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Astronomers overlap techniques of "distance ladder" to determine distances in the universe; triangulation works for nearby stars; observers use pulsating stars for farther objects, the rotation of galaxies and a class of supernova explosions.

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Measuring the Doppler shift of galaxies in the early 20th century; observations reveal that they all were moving away from Earth; the more distant ones move faster, proportional to distance; this is the Hubble Law, implying the initial "big bang."

programme.title: Cosmology: The History and Nature of Our Universe
programme.desc: Professor Whittle defines distances in cosmology; the three important distances to consider is the emission distance when the light is set out; the current distance, when the light arrives; the distance the light travels.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Turco le avisa al coronel Jiménez del nuevo cargamento que llega de Colombia, y le entrega la foto del Pombo para que sepa a quién deben arrestar, pero Leonor resulta herida en la operación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Roxana le pide dinero a Guadalupe, pero él la toma por la fuerza y se aprovecha de ella. Mónica indaga sobre los contactos de su hermano. El coronel Jiménez le cuenta a Doris sobre su ascenso.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez recibe un regalo especial. Chacorta llega a una colonia y hace un estudio para el expendio de la droga, habla con Aurelio y le dice que es una buena oportunidad de negocio en el país.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio tiene controlado todo el mercado del país con la venta en las colonias, y le pide a Irina que lo ponga en contacto con el presidente. Ella dice que con él no, pero sí con su primo.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía le dice a Jiménez que deben desmantelar la red de distribución que tienen los Casillas en las colonias. Los Villalobos llaman para pedir una cita con Aurelio.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Mejía propone que Aurelio pierda su anonimato. Mónica está furiosa porque Casillas no le contesta el celular. Ponte le dice a Marco Mejía que ya tiene a sus hombres listos para la operación.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Jiménez da luz verde para ir por Casillas, y Mejía comienza un operativo para desmantelar toda la organización. Mónica le exige a Aurelio que active el negocio con Guadalupe.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio se ofrece a ayudar a Lupe para rescatar a Mónica, pero él se niega, muy molesto. El Cabo le dice a Casillas que las cosas se complicaron: se preparan para el enfrentamiento.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dispara a Jairo y el Cabo lo remata. Casillas se deja seducir por la ardiente Mónica. Eugenia le dice a Linares que está preocupada por el artículo que escribió en el periódico.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le dice a Ximena que no se le ocurra hacerle algo al bebé que espera, ante sus reclamos. Compra un 727 para transportar la droga, mientras él y sus hombres viajan en otro avión por seguridad.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo le pregunta a Aurelio quién es Letrudo, y se une a los planes para vengarse con Chacorta y el Turco. Víctor llega al estudio de grabación para ver cómo va Matilde con el tema del disco.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: La guerrilla retiene a Aurelio y Socorro, y él le pide a Chacorta que lo rescate cuando las negociaciones se complican. La Tijera le dice a Guadalupe que Casillas recuperó la droga.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Oscar obliga a Dobladillo a hablar por teléfono con Canica, quien le da la ubicación del comandante Macario, con quien debe de estar Aurelio. Mejía y Jiménez contactan a la agente Leonor Ballesteros.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio le presenta a Mónica a la nueva piloto que contrató, pero ella la hace sentir incómoda. Ximena sorprende a su hijo Heriberto en una situación sospechosa con la tía Matilde.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Villalobos se enteran de lo que sucede con Casillas y quieren aprovechar para sacarlo del negocio. Aurelio le pide a Chacorta que les dé un susto a los periodistas para vengarse.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Marco Mejía trata de interceptar las comunicaciones de los Casillas, pero decide renunciar porque se siente culpable por las muertes de personas inocentes. Aurelio ordena eliminar a Eugenia.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Heriberto cae en las provocaciones de Matilde. Chacorta le dispara a Eugenia, pero hiere a Linares. Mejía se enfrenta a tiros con él y es Chacorta quien resulta herido, aunque logra escapar.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Aurelio jura que Mejía se las va a pagar. Doña Alba hace entrega de los documentos de un lote de terreno, con el fin de presionar para que reciban nuevamente a Rutila en la escuela.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Los Villalobos secuestran a Ximena, mientras Aurelio y Mónica se reencuentran. Doris y Jiménez organizan una cena con altos funcionarios del Gobierno por el nombramiento de Benítez.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia escucha la conversación que tiene Ramiro con Irina y decide arruinarlo. Juan Villalobos le dice a Ximena que están enterados de los amoríos de Heriberto y Matilde. Leonor activa su plan.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo visita a Aurelio para contarle que lo quieren sacar del negocio y le pide que le dé una ruta; además, lo ayudará para rescatar a Ximena. Mejía usa una estrategia que incomoda a Jiménez.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia amenaza a Ramiro con contar todo durante la reunión, pero él le advierte que, si lo hace, uno de sus socios se encargará de acabar con ella. Guadalupe atenta contra Sabino.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El presidente le pide a Mejía una lista de funcionarios sospechosos involucrados con el narcotráfico. Marco se entera de que Aurelio se infiltró en la policía y don Cleto mandó a matar a su padre.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Matilde le reprocha a Chacorta el haber tenido un hijo con Aída. Sonia se va a confesar y le pide al sacerdote una cita con el cardenal para confesarle algo muy grave, y le da una libreta negra.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: El Cabo y Tijeras se apoderan de la organización de Oscar Cadena, lo dejan herido y deciden entregarlo a las autoridades. Aurelio encuentra muertos a los Villalobos, por lo que le reclama a su suegro.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Sonia se reúne con el cardenal para enseñarle la libreta que compromete a Ramiro con el narcotráfico, y recibe una amenaza de su esposo. Leonor y Marco Mejía pasan la noche juntos.

programme.title: El señor de los cielos
programme.desc: Eugenia se molesta con el cambio en el periódico. Mejía convence a Jiménez de no estar dispuesto a trabajar más con Leonor, y ella entra al estudio de grabación haciéndose pasar por fan de Alejo.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.sub-title: Un nacimiento imprevisto; Persona de interés

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Tebelio desaparece al viajar en balsa hacia Estados Unidos, lo dan por muerto, pero está vivo. Antonio le compra a María unas tierras en Colombia que resultaron ser de un capo de la droga.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Misael exige que Loreta le pague por haber matado a la serpiente que tenía como mascota. Susan es una maestra con novedosos métodos, la expulsan y pide que la escuela le pague lo que le debe.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Anabel exige compensación por desempleo, su jefe la despidió por negarse a trabajar con una prótesis que remarca su vagina. Brenda quiere que su hija se divorcie y el desalojo de su yerno.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Mariela quiere recuperar la custodia de su hija, pero Criss, el padre de la niña, se niega. Por otro lado, Mabel conoce a un chico haitiano con una historia de vida complicada, él la engaña.

programme.title: Caso cerrado

programme.desc: Quiere que su esposa embarazada deje de comer pollo porque afecta el tamaño del pene del bebé. Tuvieron un encuentro sexual con su pareja de inquilinos, ella quiere repetir y él que se marchen.
programme.sub-title: El problema eres tú; El inquilino

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su marido no solo abusa de ella, sino que además, es el asesino de su anterior esposa. Una "baby-sitter" tiene un incidente en la casa donde cuida de una niña, pero quien muere es su propia hija.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Asegura que su anciana hermana murió por la excitación sexual que experimentó con dos strippers. Le dan poco presupuesto para una publicidad musical y el resultado es una auténtica basura.
programme.sub-title: Muerta de alegría; Música para mis oídos

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Katherine busca desalojar a la suegra por los experimentos que hace. Los padres dejaron que la menor embarazada se case, ella queda emancipada para algunas cosas, pero no para otras.
programme.sub-title: El homúnculo; La niña y el abusador

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Natacha queda como la única heredera de su papá, pero su media hermana Claudia tiene otro testamento. Por otro lado, una familia contacta a la receptora del corazón que donó su hijo fallecido.
programme.sub-title: Mi hermana es una asesina; De corazón

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Pierde su brazo y ahora enfrenta un grave problema, no puede ejercer su profesión. Descubre que su pareja tenía otra familia y toma represalias, ahora le exigen el pago de los gastos médicos.
programme.sub-title: La vida es bella; La culpa es tuya

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Responsabiliza a Mayra del secuestro de su hijo, quiere que la ayude con el rescate. La residencia de ancianos lucra con la muerte al ofrecer sus cuerpos para pruebas con armas y explosivos.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su mente le hace creer que padece enfermedades que él mismo se provoca, pero no quiere ir al psicólogo. Nace sin pene y le implantan uno biónico, pero al tener intimidad, cae en coma.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Su exesposo no quiere incluir en la división de bienes unas monedas valiosas. Morfeo le pide a su sacristán que cumpla sexualmente por él, y ahora Magdalena quiere manutención para su hijo.
programme.sub-title: Hasta que la realidad nos separe; Hijo del sacerdote

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: Eva acusa a su novio Daniel de usar lubricante con éxtasis, ella da positivo en la prueba de drogas y la botan del trabajo. Carlos pide el divorcio porque Cindy le fue infiel con un famoso DJ.

programme.title: Caso cerrado
programme.desc: María exige que Elena le pague por los daños que su hija, con síndrome de Down, sufrió en su academia. Jaime es menor de edad y su madre pide la anulación de su boda, porque él la engañó.
programme.sub-title: Abusada con síndrome de Down; Me lo cazó

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa run into Home Hill to say 'Eh-oh', but where 's Po? Some children help their dad to wash his car. They get very wet and soapy.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies crawl through the arch in Home Hill and watch Alex Pascall and some children sing 'Handy Hands'.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children play with balls of different shapes and sizes. In Teletubbyland, something happens to Dipsy's hat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: It's time for the Teletubbies to do their exercises. A voice trumpet rises and the Teletubbies stretch up and down to it's instructions.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number two. Dipsy and Laa-Laa are eating Tubby Toast. They play the game 'Two Little Teletubbies', but while they are playing the Noo-Noo tidies up their Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies take turns to stand on a hill, in front of the house, next to a tree under a cloud. Andy Brown and some children visit some giraffes. The animals march through Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are eating Tubby Toast. They stop to watch Amy making pasta. A ball of string appears in Teletubbyland. Po knocks the string in to the air with her scooter and it makes a stringy mess all over Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky calls the other Tubbies to come and watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story about the naughty sock. The Tubby Toast machine makes a tower of tubby toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children looking at penguins waddling and swimming. In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies play walk fast and slow, far and near and other different ways.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies play 'Boo', but stop to watch Ned help his dad plant and water some geraniums. In Teletubbyland, nine pretty flowers and a watering can appear.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies love playing on the slide. They stop to watch Andy Brown and some children digging in the sand for crabs.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Samira and her friends show the Teletubbies their gymnastic routines. The Teletubbies do their own gymnastics.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Matthew and James help their uncle milk the cows. In Teletubbyland, the Tubby Custard machine isn't working, so they sing a special 'Tubby Custard' song. Then, the Tubby Custard machine works again.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and the Teletubbies dance, before watching two girls do some Flamenco dancing with their teacher. It's time for the Teletubbies to wash their feet. They love using their Tubby Sponges.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little boy peel and mash some eggs for an egg mayonnaise sandwich. The Teletubbies laugh when they make a tune whilst eating their Tubby Custard.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance around the trees and watch some children drum with their friend Norris. Tinky Winky dance on the roof of Home Hill and wakes up the other Tubbies.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Dipsy says "Eh-oh" and runs off to find the other Tubbies. They watch some children make fantastic animals from papermache.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch a little girl who loves monkeys help her mum feed them in a zoo. Tinky Winky sits down to eat some Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky says "Eh-oh". The Teletubbies and some children watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be the Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty hat. The Teletubbies are very happy when they find their favourite things to play with.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: In Teletubbyland, the Tubbies are trying to be quiet. They watch Oscar read the story of the Gingerbread Boy to his brother Felix. A voice trumpet appears and sings the nursery rhyme.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Po fetches the other to watch Andy Brown and two children look for some rabbits. In Teletubbyland, Tinky Winky is looking for Po. He looks for her everywhere, but she is hiding from him. When he finds her all the Tubbies dance a happy dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance an up and down dance. They watch some children painting pictures and patterns on to eggs. In Teletubbyland, Laa-Laa dances with her ball until the magical tree appears.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa sit down to eat some Tubby Custard. Po wants some too. She tries to eat the other's Tubby Custard, but they won't let her.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch a little boy show us how to make a Turban. The Tubbies go for a walk, but Po, Laa-Laa and Dipsy want to play with their favourite things.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and teaches the Teletubbies a nursery rhyme. Then they watch Becky go for a ride on a Tram. Po rides her scooter too fast and knocks the other Tubbies over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Tubbies watch some children are playing football in the park. Laa-Laa and Po love playing with the ball. While they play they sing a song about the ball.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies pop up from behind a hill to watch Tamzin Griffin pretend to be Funny Lady and tell the story of the naughty sausage. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po go for a walk, so Laa-Laa decides to dance a secret dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies want to go to sleep, but Tinky Winky finds Po already asleep in his bed. So he goes to look for somewhere else to sleep.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children learn about the number three. Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Laa-Laa go for a walk. They count three trees and three flowers and Po follows behind counting too.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep when a voice trumpet appears singing the rhyme 'Frére Jacques'. The Teletubbies laugh and call "Again, again!"

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies see a little girl and her brother who love salad. They go shopping in a market a market with their grandma to buy some salad to eat.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch two boys make Chinese Lanterns with their uncle. In Teletubbyland, it is time for Tubby Toast, but where has Laa-Laa's toast gone?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises and makes the Teletubbies laugh. They watch some children exploring the colour green. The Teletubbies love green.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies and some children learn about the colour blue. In Teletubbyland Po is watching the blue sky when it begins to rain.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Noo-Noo tidies up Home hill before the Teletubbies slide up the slide to watch Natalie tell us about her brother's christening.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch Sarah and Mark give their sheep a winter-feed. In Teletubbyland, the Teletubbies cannot decide whether to have Tubby Custard or Tubby Toast.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies leave their favourite things to watch some boys spinning some spinning tops to celebrate the Hanukah festival. Tinky Winky wears the skirt on his head to do a very special round and round dance.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies dance a jumping dance before stopping to watch Yvette wash up her plastic cups and saucers. The Teletubbies have a very messy day. So Noo-Noo has to tidy everything up.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies are asleep, but Noo-Noo tidies up their blankets. They stop chasing him to watch some children learn about the number five. A flashing light appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet rises to tell the Teletubbies 'Christmas is a Coming'. They hurry up the slide to see some children decorate a Christmas Tree. The Teletubbies get excited when their own Christmas Tree appears in Teletubbyland.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: The Teletubbies watch some children making Christmas cards. Laa-Laa's present is some lovely decorations. When Noo-Noo tidies them up they tickle his throat, so he throws them out to decorate Home Hill.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: Two children are making Christmas crackers for each other. Dipsy is very pleased to find his present is a cracker. He looks for someone to pull the cracker. It makes a lovely pink bang and the Teletubbies laugh when they fall over.

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A group of children sing some Christmas carols to the Teletubbies. Tinky Winky opens his present to find a beautiful star inside. The Teletubbies follow it all over Teletubbyland, but where will is end up?

programme.title: Teletubbies (Classic)
programme.desc: A voice trumpet appears and teaches the Teletubbies a winter nursery rhyme. Po's present is a little frosty cloud that begins to snow. All the Teletubbies laugh as they play in the snow.

programme.desc: The Teletubbies see some children visit a level crossing and watch a train pass by. The Teletubbies play their Ready, Steady, Go game.
